title: Reproducibility standard (immutable container digests, version pinning, run-manifest schema, numeric-tolerance policy, countable-assertion unit)
context: The project's core value is making cancer-proteomics reanalyses reproducible by a third party. Without a binding standard that mandates immutable container digests, version-pinned tools, a machine-readable run manifest, and a declared numeric-tolerance policy, individual pipeline tasks will diverge on what 'reproducible' means. The standard must also fix the countable 'assertion' unit so the 100%-provenance CI gate is mechanically verifiable rather than aspirational.
objective: Publish the project's reproducibility standard, covering: immutable container digest requirements (no floating tags), pinned tool and reference-DB versions with checksums, the run-manifest schema, the numeric-tolerance policy for non-deterministic stages, and the definition of the countable assertion unit the provenance CI gate measures.
acceptanceCriteria: The standard mandates immutable container digests (no floating tags) and pinned tool plus reference-DB versions with SHA-256 checksums on all pipeline components.

The run-manifest schema is defined, capturing: dataset accession + input checksums, container digests, tool versions, all parameters, reference-DB versions/checksums, random seeds, operator, environment, and duration.
The countable 'assertion' unit is fixed (e.g., one published result-table row / one differential comparison / one summary statistic) so the 100%-provenance CI gate is mechanically checkable.

The numeric-tolerance policy is stated: exact match where pipeline stages are deterministic; a declared, justified per-stage tolerance band for non-deterministic stages (search engines, some quant steps); tolerance is published with each reanalysis.
The standard document is licensed CC-BY-4.0 and committed to the project repo.
resources: PLAN.md — Solution approach & architecture, Key decisions section
TASKS.md — M0 acceptance criteria for repro-standard-003
output: A committed reproducibility standard document defining immutable container digest requirements, the run-manifest schema, the numeric-tolerance policy, and the countable assertion unit; licensed CC-BY-4.0.
